confidence_notes: Holistic estimate with no live listings checked. Meal and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates swing with July demand. Cocktail and wine are scaled from the local beer price because direct knowledge is weak; beer assumes a 0.5 L draft. FX: the 2026-10-14 value came from a search summary attributed to RBA pages; I did not open the RBA table, search results conflicted, and no independent source confirmed the 13-14 October figures, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Krakow is priced as a tourist-heavy Polish city above national averages; accommodation is benchmarked loosely to Central European city-break rates in July.
